== Story 636: English errata source audit ==
Compared the actual English original/later faces and primary replacement paragraphs. [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, p. 2. [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, edition dated 30 July 2023, p. 105. The actual Dark Side original and later faces were inspected separately from their Light Side counterparts. The Supplement p. 2 replaces the original habitat and grabbing instructions. Appendix A p. 105 later supplies parasite and relocation wording. No matching full face was located for the intermediate. The comparison preserves complete clauses; following ruling paragraphs and attributes supplied only by rules are not inserted into printed Game Text. The examined original and current full card faces show the same statistics and unrestricted uniqueness. The separate 2013 slip-title discrepancy remains unresolved below. Canonical titles, article corrections, documentary states and Versions changes are coordinated with Story 617; this packet proposes shared-table transclusions only. --

=== Historical slip title discrepancy ===
The Players Committee's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (official text as of 1 January 2013) prints a uniqueness dot with the Dark Side Bog-wing caption and footer on PDF page 5. The Light Side slip on PDF page 21 and the examined original and current full card faces do not show that dot. The cover instructs readers to cut the area beneath the card title and place it with the original card. The discrepancy is recorded here without deciding whether it represents a historical erratum or a slip-production error; that investigation remains with Story 617. The comparison preserves the separately verified complete Original, Glossary Supplement and later PC wordings. It does not add a unique-card state or allocate an ID from this unresolved artifact.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Players Committee, Decipher Errata], cover and PDF pages 5 and 21. The full historical PDF preserves the literal caption and footer for further review.
